full_judgment:
Md Fazlul Karim J: This petition for leave to appeal at the instance of Sadharan Bima Corporation is directed against the judgment and order dated 8-4-2002 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in First Miscellaneous Appeal No. 303 of 2002 dismissing the same affirming those dated 25-5-2000 of the Subordinate Judge, (Joint District Judge) 3rd Court, Dhaka in Miscellaneous Case No. 451 of 1992 in appointing an Arbitrator. 

 5. Mr Tofailur Rahman, the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner, submitted that the Hon'ble Judges of the High Court Division misconstrued the expression 'dispute' as referred to in clause 18 of the Insurance Policy (liability being otherwise admitted) such difference could be the subject-matter of arbitration. But in the instant case there being no admission of liability by the petitioner since the petitioner repudiated the total claim of the respondent vide letter dated 12-7-1990, there was no scope for referring the matter to arbitration and the loss voucher for Taka 16,75,809 only being the proceeds of salvaged hessian cloth cannot be construed as admission of liability by the petitioner. The learned Counsel further submitted that the learned Subordinate Judge as well as the Hon'ble Judges of the High Court Division failed to appreciate that there was no dispute/difference between the petitioner and respondent with regard to the amount of claim under the Insurance Policy as stipulated in the condition No. 18 of the said Policy. 

 11. In the instant case, the Courts below have concurrently found the difference to be covered by clause 18 of the Insurance Policy. It is the cardinal principle of law attached to the law of arbitration which plays a very much significant role in the matter of consensual resolution of dispute being an alternative dispute resolution mechanism i.e., arbitration is the intention of the legislature, instead of dragging the parties to the protracted litigation which is not only time consuming and costly but strains the commercial relationship between the parties.
